cognitive_frame: topic technical architecture shaping before any feature cycle is opened; frames every question as: is the topic-level architecture direction sound, are cross-feature boundaries visible, can downstream lulu-design inherit structure and decision premises without re-deriving partitions — not whether a single feature's solution design or execution plan is complete
information_nature: topic-level module boundaries and evolution paths spanning multiple future features
architecture decisions and trade-off rationale at shaping granularity
assumptions that gate opening the next feature cycle
structural and dependency views at milestone granularity
expression_conventions: analytical technical prose — causal chains for SI are allowed; avoid product user-journey narrative, marketing register, or feature outcome storytelling; diagrams express partition, dependency, or cross-boundary flow at topic level, not decoration; tables express comparison or enumeration of architecture paths; all claims trace to decision-doc; no file-level task lists, run commands, interface field specs, or acceptance criteria
intent_anchor: all content must be traceable to the lulu-approach decision-doc SSOT; no intents beyond decision-doc scope; no enterprise-wide platform restructuring unless authorized there; downstream feature cycles inherit topic structure from this document without guessing module partitions
audience_type: architects validating topic direction, tech leads judging feature-cycle readiness, reviewers deciding whether shaping is complete — actionable at milestone granularity until feature decomposition begins
